company.name: Abdex Industries
company.tagline: Fluid transfer solutions up to 60,000 psi (4,135 bar)
company.description: A family owned and run business established in 1974. Abdex services the marine, offshore, defence, manufacturing, pharmaceutical and mining industries. Abdex offers low, medium, high and ultra high-pressure fluid transfer solutions up to 60,000 psi (4,135 bar) and an extensive variety of fittings, valves and instrumentation components, pressure test systems and hose manufacturing machinery.

services.name: Hose Testing and Assembly
services.description: Pressure testing and certification is a key element of what Abdex does. Abdex provides onsite inspection, assembling and pressure testing of hose assemblies. The dedicated service team handles hose assembly and certifies assemblies to the required working pressure.

services.name: Hose Management System (A-track)
services.description: Keeping track of high pressure assets is constant and often difficult work. The A-track system incorporates individual product etching and state-of-the-art RFID technology for tracking assets.

services.name: Machine Service, Calibration & Training
services.description: Abdex offers a full training and installation service. Service, calibration and training is available for Uniflex hose machinery and other equipment.

services.name: Rental Equipment
services.description: Abdex stocks a range of pressure control equipment available to rent at short notice with highly competitive rates.

services.name: Umbilical Hose
services.description: Abdex has facilities for hose bundling (umbilicals) and Hydraulic Flying Leads (HFLs). Umbilical hoses bundle multiple hose lines together for subsea and offshore applications.
